translations.text: Rejoice now in spirit, and grow to be a comfort to your Lord, and raise up your glory. Guard the treasure-chamber of your heart, and bind your thoughts fast within your mind.
Many a trusted companion proves unreliable; they fail at times, and promises made in words grow weak. So this world goes: it rushes on in storms and endures its fate.
There is one faith, one living One, one baptism, one eternal Father, one Lord of the people, who created this earth, its blessings and its joys.

Glory grew afterwards, though this transitory creation had long stood hidden in darkness, concealed under a covering [?], well covered with trees [?], wrapped in gloom, until a young maiden, brave of heart, grew up among mankind.
There it then pleased [?] the Holy Spirit in that treasure-vessel. Bright, he shone in the br[?], he who was the origin of all light.
